resources.string: This service only inspects the foreground application package name to detect when your child exceeds their screen time limit and displays the blocking screen. Personal data, passwords, messages, or keystrokes are never collected or transmitted off-device.
Parental screen time limiter and app management companion for children.
Ask your parent for additional screen time.
You have used up your daily allowed time for this app.

Parental Control uses the Android AccessibilityService API to instantly detect when a time-restricted application is launched.

• What is monitored? Only the package name of the active foreground application.
• What is NOT monitored? Keystrokes, personal messages, passwords, screen contents, or private information are STRICTLY NOT monitored or collected.
• Purpose: To show the lock screen whenever daily limits are exceeded.
• Privacy: No data is saved or transmitted off the device.

To function properly, Parental Control needs access to app usage data (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS).

• What is accessed? Daily usage time of installed applications.
• Purpose: To monitor and enforce daily screen time limits configured by parents.
• Privacy: This data is never sent over the Internet, uploaded to any server, or shared with third parties. It remains strictly on your device.
